name: video_subtitles
description: Add subtitles to a video. mode burn (default) draws them into the picture so they show everywhere, including social media; mode soft adds a subtitle track that viewers can switch on and off (mp4, mov, mkv, webm) without re-encoding. Works well with transcripts from video_transcript or .srt files downloaded by media_download.

input.description: Path of the video file, relative to the workspace.

subtitles.description: Subtitle file (.srt, .vtt, .ass or .ssa), relative to the workspace.

language.description: For soft subtitles: ISO 639 language code such as en or eng.

font_size.description: Font size for burned SRT/VTT subtitles. Default: the renderer's default.

position.description: Burned SRT/VTT subtitles at the bottom (default) or top.

output.description: Path for the result, relative to the workspace. The extension picks the format. Default: next to the input as <name>_subtitled.<ext>. An existing file is never replaced unless overwrite is true.

quality.description: Encoding quality when re-encoding: high (visually lossless, larger files), medium, or low (smallest). Default high.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Default false.
